worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.summary: Coil your thoughts until they gather into a single bright point overhead: Special Attack rises sharply for a visible window. It needs no foe at all, so you can scheme before a fight; with a foe to fix on, the window lasts longer. When the window ends or is cleared, only the stages this move raised are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.use.0: Lay a scheme before the fight and push Sp. Atk as high as it goes
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.use.1: Start the scheme the moment a foe shows and you have a gap
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.use.2: Scheme while travelling, with no foe in sight
Nasty Plot raises Special Attack by %1$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.wary.on: Careful scheme: Sp. Atk +2 and a longer window, but 4 more windup ticks and a longer cooldown; usable at any time, no foe required.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.wary.off: Quick scheme: Sp. Atk +1 and a shorter window, but a faster windup and cooldown. Strong-but-slow against weak-but-fast, each has its moment.
Scheme reach %1$s blocks, lasting about %2$s; a fixable foe within reach extends the window by ×1.15. When the window ends or is cleared, only the Sp. Atk stages this scheme raised are taken back. You hold position while casting.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.growth.0: At level %1$s the scheme lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.growth.1: At level %1$s the scheme reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.preference.w: On: careful scheme, Sp. Atk +2 and a longer window, but 4 more windup ticks and a longer cooldown. Off: quick scheme, Sp. Atk +1 and a shorter window with a faster windup and cooldown. Both work at any time with no foe required.
worldcombat.skill.nastyplot.preference.a: Consider a scheme when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of scheming; larger gives up setup more often up close.
